actual_Boolean_family: G(z,y)=g_z(y), each g_0,g_1 a quadratic Boolean phase; one physical selector bit, shared data cube
parameter_domain: All quadratic polynomial pairs on n=0,1,2,3 data bits, modulo simultaneous global sign by q0 constant=0: 2,8,128,8192 cases. Targeted n=4: 256 deterministic coefficient-mask pairs plus 4 rank endpoints. n=6: 8 fixed rank/collision endpoints. No automatic dimension growth.
symmetry: Only simultaneous global sign of both children removed; entropy, influence, selector decrement invariant. Selector orientation retained.
arithmetic: integer signed Walsh, Fraction; prime-log entropy expressions; GF(2) rank, affine-support overlap; rational log enclosures via atanh with proved tail only for certificate comparison
